name: certificate_38
description: The lower-bound certificate of data/lower_bound/lower_bound_38.json: two simple heptagons whose boundaries meet in 38 points.

name: easy_lens_2
description: Two convex heptagons overlapping in a lens.

name: easy_bars_cross_4
description: A horizontal bar and a vertical bar, each a simple heptagon, crossing once.

name: easy_slotted_and_bar_8
description: A slotted heptagon (a pocket cut into its base) crossed by a bar: four sides of P pass through the bar, twice each.

name: easy_turned_pair_14
description: A convex heptagon and a turned copy of it, concentric: the boundaries cross the maximum 14 times for two convex heptagons (2 per side of P).

name: awkward_vertex_in_edge_interior
description: Q5 lies exactly in the INTERIOR of P-side 0. (E9)/NoVertexOnOther fails: this is the vertex-on-side degeneracy AKR section 9.2 removes.

name: awkward_three_collinear_in_P
description: P0, P1, P2 are collinear (P1 sits inside the segment P0-P2), so P's base is one straight line split into two sides. SimpleClosed accepts this; general position does not. Q zig-zags across the base, twice on each side.

name: awkward_shared_vertex
description: P and Q share a vertex exactly (P0 = Q0). This is the vertex-vertex coincidence AKR section 9.1 removes; points9_le_38_of_coincFree assumes it away.

name: awkward_tangential_touch
description: The two boundaries touch at one point without crossing: Q sits on the outside of P-side 0 and meets it only at Q0.

name: awkward_overlapping_sides_infinite
description: A P-side and a Q-side are collinear and overlap in a whole sub-segment, so the boundaries meet in infinitely many points. Must be FLAGGED, not counted.
